core.export.noLine: no dashboard-state line in the published .keep-the-why ({raw}) — this project has no published export yet
core.export.otherRepository: the export at {url} belongs to {claimed}, not to {canonical}
core.see.noEntry: its published export (generated {generated}) has no entry with this Id — the reference may be newer than the export, or the entry lives below the repository's top level
core.see.notAsked: not known here, and no published export was asked for
core.see.unreadable: its published export could not be read
family.fetch.cache: Or the read-only context cache, shared by every project on this machine:
family.fetch.clone: A working tree, writable (the mapping learns it on next start):
family.fetch.summary: not checked out here — how to get it
family.page.heading: Family
family.page.none: This project is not part of a family: no parent line, no children block in .keep-the-why.
family.page.sub: The whole tree this project belongs to, from the root down: each project under the one whose children block lists it. That block is the routing — where an entry about something belongs; what is wider than a level goes one level up, to the root at most. Every member can be read; a member checked out here can be written to. Not a dependency graph.
family.why.exportFailed: could not read the published export
family.why.needsLive: a member's state needs the live server
family.why.noBodies: entry texts are not available on this page
family.why.noExports: published exports are not available on this page
family.why.notFilled: the host answered without the entry texts
family.why.notHere: not checked out or cached on this machine
friends.card.forkOf: — a fork of {of}, by its own export
friends.card.noneBack: None of its entries cites an entry here.
friends.card.reachedByThought: Nothing here cites it directly — it was reached by following a thought.
friends.cited: who in the registry cites this project?
friends.citedTitle: who in the Keep the Why registry cites this project — one file from the registry, loaded on this click
friends.heading: Friends
friends.none: No entry here cites a repository outside the family yet. A See line into another project — its canonical and an entry's Id — makes it a friend.
friends.registryHeading: Citing this project — from the registry
friends.registryNote: Repositories in the Keep the Why registry whose entries cite this project, from its backlink file. Citations from outside the registry are not in it.
friends.registryNoteBuilt: Repositories in the Keep the Why registry whose entries cite this project, from its backlink file, built {date}. Citations from outside the registry are not in it.
friends.sub: Repositories the entries here cite outside the family — linked into the graph, never merged into search, queues or counts. A friend in a family comes as the whole family. One hop: a friend's own friends are not loaded; walk there to see them.
pages.authors.col.author: Author
pages.authors.heading: Authors
pages.authors.howTo: Click a name to open the author's profile on the host; click elsewhere in the row to filter every view to that author, again to clear. Click a column's name to sort by it, again to turn the order round.
pages.authors.howToMany: A name that recurs across projects is one row with the sums; a name an export anonymized (author-1) says nothing across projects and stays a row per project.
pages.authors.noGit: No Git repository — nothing to attribute.
pages.authors.sortBy.author: Sort by author
pages.authors.sub: Git authors of the entries — who created, touched, or superseded what, in every project this page holds: this one, its family, the friends in the graph, the path. Git knows names, not who was driving.
pages.copy.entryTitle:
copy a link to this entry — {where}:
{url}
pages.copy.label: ⧉ copy link
pages.copy.topicTitle:
copy a link to this topic — {where}:
{url}
pages.details.idTitle: the entry's address — what See and Superseded by lines resolve to
pages.details.linkedAfterWhy: This entry is in question ({status}); these later entries are linked after it — check whether they depend on it.
pages.findings.heading: Linter findings
pages.findings.sub: keep-the-why-lint {linter} · {errors} error(s), {warnings} warning(s) · structure only, never content
pages.lookup.family: Looking for {uuid} in the family's published exports…
pages.lookup.familyNone: No entry with Id {uuid} in this export, nor in the family's published exports.
pages.lookup.live: Looking for {uuid} in the other projects known here…
pages.lookup.liveNone: No entry with Id {uuid} in this project, nor in any other project known here. A family member that is not checked out can be cloned or cached — see Family.
pages.overview.shallow: · shallow clone (dates are the clone's edge)
pages.queues.heading: Queues
pages.queues.needsReviewWhy: Status: needs-review — a Revisit-when trigger fired and nobody re-checked yet.
pages.queues.openWhy: Status: open — the entry's central question has no answer yet.
pages.queues.pendingWhy: Written in an unattended session where a question would have been asked; never confirmed by anyone.
pages.queues.revisitWhy: The conditions on record. Whether one has fired is a human judgement; the dashboard cannot tell.
pages.queues.sub: What needs a person. The dashboard lists; it does not decide.
pages.queues.unknownWhy: Where the claim came from could not be traced — on any entry still in force, an open question included: Evidence and Status are separate axes. A maintainer can often settle these in a minute.
pages.ref.stale: · Id not found here — the locator may be stale
pages.refs.familyMissing: {n:family member} not available here — not looked through.
pages.refs.familyNone: No references to this entry from the rest of the family.
pages.refs.familyScope: References from the rest of the family show with the family scope — the switch next to the project menu.
pages.refs.looking: Looking for references from the rest of the family…
pages.refs.seenFromFamily: Referenced by (See), elsewhere in the family
search.dropdown.head: Results in this project
search.dropdown.registryPage: ↵  projects in the registry, as a page
search.filtered: · {n} match the sidebar filters, the rest dimmed
search.heading: Search {q}
search.missingFamily: Family shows how to get a member that is not on this machine.
search.missingFriends: Friends lists the repositories the entries cite outside the family, and what could not be loaded.
search.none.all: No entry matches “{q}” in the family or the friends.
search.none.project: No entry matches “{q}” in this project.
search.none.projectMore: No entry matches “{q}” in this project — {more}.
search.scopeTitle: where to search — the switch next to the project menu sets the graph and the lists, not the search; registry: a project rather than entries
search.textless: Searched without the entry texts in {names}: {errors}.
search.tooShort: Type at least two characters in the search field and press Enter.
thoughts.list.beyondNote: Shorter chains that continue in a repository this page has not loaded — loading it may make them thoughts.
thoughts.list.followAllTitle: load every repository the chains here go on into, hop by hop — nothing else
thoughts.list.followTitle: load the repositories this chain goes on into — {repos} — hop by hop, until it ends
thoughts.list.heading: Thoughts ({n}) {min}
thoughts.list.none: No chain of linked entries in this graph yet — a thought is a chain of See or Superseded by, each entry citing the one before.
thoughts.list.note: Chains of linked entries — See and Superseded by — first entry first. Point at one to light its path, click to hold it.
thoughts.list.readTitle: read the whole thought — every entry in order, in full
thoughts.min.title: entries a thought has at least — from one link up to the longest chain here
thoughts.page.beyondNote: Chains that continue in a repository this page has not loaded.
thoughts.page.bridgesNote: Entries in the middle of several chains — where many links pass through.
thoughts.page.evolutionsNote: One decision, replaced step by step.
thoughts.page.fansFromNote: Entries several chains start from — often a decision much else refers to.
thoughts.page.fansToNote: Entries at the end of several chains — where chains from different starts arrive.
thoughts.page.heading: Thoughts {min}
thoughts.page.none: No chain of linked entries here yet — a thought is a chain of See or Superseded by, each entry citing the one before.
thoughts.page.recentNote: Lines whose newest step is the newest — where reasoning is moving now.
thoughts.page.restingNote: Lines that have not grown for the longest time — settled, or forgotten.
thoughts.page.shakyHeading: Chains through a step in question
thoughts.page.shakyNote: Entries in question — open, needing review, waiting for confirmation, or replaced yet still cited — and the later entries linked after them. If one of these changes, these are the entries to check: whether they depend on it is for a person to say.
thoughts.page.shakyRowProjects: {why} · {n:later entry|later entries} linked after it, in {projects} projects
thoughts.page.sub: Chains of linked entries: each cites the one before (See) or replaced it (Superseded by) — in this graph, with its family, friends and path. A link says two entries are related; often one follows from the other, not always. Point at a chain to light it in the graph beside.
thoughts.page.weakNote: Chains whose first entry has Evidence inferred or unknown. Where later entries depend on it, they depend on a reason nobody confirmed — the first entry is the place to ask.
thoughts.pill.shakyLater: {n} later steps are linked after it
thoughts.pill.shakyLaterOne: {n} later step is linked after it
thoughts.pill.weakTitle: its first entry's Evidence is {evidence}: where later entries depend on it, they depend on a reason nobody confirmed
thoughts.reader.affected: Linked after step {i}, which is in question.
thoughts.reader.evolutionSub: One decision, replaced step by step — from the first version to the one in force.
thoughts.reader.goesOnAfter: ↓ After its newest entry, it goes on in {repos} — not loaded on this page. {button}
thoughts.reader.goesOnBefore: ↑ Before its origin, it goes on in {repos} — not loaded on this page. {button}
thoughts.reader.heading: A thought in {n} entries
thoughts.reader.missing: Entry {id} is not loaded on this page — it lives in a project outside it (a friend, or a step of a path); load the friends in the graph, or walk there.
thoughts.reader.oneDay: All its steps were written on {date}.
thoughts.reader.shaky: In question — {why}. {n:later step} are linked after it — worth checking whether they depend on it.
thoughts.reader.shakyOne: In question — {why}. {n:later step} is linked after it — worth checking whether they depend on it.
thoughts.reader.sub: A chain of linked entries, each citing the one before — read from the first to the last. A link says two entries are related: often that one follows from the other, not always.
thoughts.reader.weak: Its first entry's Evidence is {evidence}. Where a later step depends on it, it depends on a reason nobody confirmed.
timeline.arrange.title: where a card stands: where its node stands in the graph beside (the stage is the graph, time pulled out as depth), or in a lane per topic
timeline.bars.title: {month} · {author}: {n} — click: that month's entries, and the day moves to its end
timeline.card.letGoTitle: let go — back to the latest entry by the day shown
timeline.foreign.label: others
timeline.foreign.title: other repositories' entries — friends, family, path: only the ones a chain of See or Superseded by joins to this project's, every one the graph holds, or none
timeline.heading: Timeline
timeline.hint.days: On the stage: wheel — a day forward or back, shift for a week · drag — look around · ctrl+wheel — zoom · double-click — reset the view · click a card to read it, the floor to let go. The thoughts beside: point at one to light its chain here and in the graph.
timeline.hint.hours: On the stage: wheel — an hour forward or back, shift for a day · drag — look around · ctrl+wheel — zoom · double-click — reset the view · click a card to read it, the floor to let go. The thoughts beside: point at one to light its chain here and in the graph.
timeline.hint.touch: On the stage: drag — look around · pinch — zoom · tap a card to read it, the floor to let go. The slider sets the day.
timeline.noGit: No Git repository — no dates to draw.
timeline.range.days: the day the page shows — drag, or ← → (a day), shift ← → (a week), space plays
timeline.range.hours: the hour the page shows — drag, or ← → (an hour), shift ← → (a day), space plays
timeline.reset.label: reset
timeline.reset.title: let go of the held thought and card — every card alike again — and reset the view (Esc)
timeline.shallow: Shallow clone: the history stops at the clone's edge, so every entry older than that appears to start there. Fetch the full history (git fetch --unshallow) for real dates.
timeline.sub: The project day by day. The stage shows what existed on the day shown, the graph beside it the same; the playhead sets the day. The card shows the entry that appeared last by then, or the one clicked on the stage. The bars count the entries by the month their heading first appeared in Git, stacked by author, grey ticks for entries superseded that month.
ui.fork.byCanonical: origin differs from the project's `canonical` (.keep-the-why): this checkout is a fork or mirror of it
ui.fork.byUpstream: this checkout has an `upstream` remote: origin is a fork of it
